title: phyllanthus albus
intro: Phyllanthus albus, commonly known as White Phyllanthus or White Chaffflower, is a plant species within the family Phyllanthaceae. It is a shrub-like plant native to tropical regions, valued for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant is reported to have various therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress, improving liver function, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Phyllanthus albus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal effects.
